WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1792616769937
    AND e.ts_ms < 1793221569937
    AND e.event IN ('$pageview', '$pageleave')
),
pv AS (SELECT distinct_id FROM ev WHERE event = '$pageview'),
s AS (
  SELECT session_id, MIN(ts_ms) AS start_ms, MAX(ts_ms) AS end_ms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event = '$pageview' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pvs
  FROM ev GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT distinct_id) FROM pv) AS visitors,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pv) AS pageviews,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s WHERE pvs > 0) AS sessions,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s WHERE pvs = 1) AS bounces,
  (SELECT SUM(end_ms - start_ms) FROM s WHERE pvs > 0) AS duration_ms

SELECT bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS pageviews
FROM (SELECT ((ts_ms / 86400000) * 86400000) AS bucket, distinct_id FROM ev) t
GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket LIMIT 5000

SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'pages' AS dim, val, COUNT(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(path, ''), '(none)') AS val, distinct_id FROM ev WHERE event = '$pageview') t
  GROUP BY val ORDER BY visitors DESC, n DESC LIMIT 10
) pages_t
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT 'entry_pages' AS dim, val, COUNT(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM (
    SELECT ev.session_id, MIN(COALESCE(NULLIF(ev.path, ''), '(none)')) AS val, MIN(ev.distinct_id) AS distinct_id
    FROM (SELECT session_id, MIN(ts_ms) AS t FROM ev WHERE event = '$pageview' GROUP BY session_id) x
    JOIN ev ON ev.session_id = x.session_id AND ev.ts_ms = x.t AND ev.event = '$pageview'
    GROUP BY ev.session_id
  ) t
  GROUP BY val ORDER BY visitors DESC, n DESC LIMIT 10
) entry_pages_t
UNION ALL
